v2_egyptian_taxonomy.model: yolov8n fine-tuned (30 epochs, lr0=0.003, cos decay), imgsz 320
v2_egyptian_taxonomy.dataset: 269 hand-reviewed Egyptian-market images, 23 classes (Egyptian types/grades), 85/15 split (233 train / 36 val), full-image boxes; per-image provenance in data/provenance2.csv
honest_caveats: Classes with >=8 training images (12 of 23) reach AP50 0.995 with high precision.

Classes with 2-7 training images (copper_red, steel_scrap, brass, aluminum_shavings, copper_scrap, steel_pipes, brick_white, sand, steel_sheet) score near zero on their single val image; more Egyptian source images are needed for these.
wood_zan vs wood_swed confusion is the dominant error among strong classes (the two woods are visually near-identical).
